subject.title: Feature request: Per-channel tool call budget with auto-delegation

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a generic budget with channel overrides and defer automatic subagent delegation until its security and handoff contract is separately approved?
rationale: Maintainer intent is required to choose configuration precedence, transcript and terminal-state semantics, and the authority inherited by automatically created child sessions.

options.title: Budget first, delegate later
options.body: Land a generic opt-in budget with channel or group overrides and deterministic block or warning behavior, then design automatic delegation separately.

options.title: Design full overflow policy
options.body: Specify warn, block, and automatic delegation together, including model, tools, sandbox, context, credentials, target, and completion delivery.

options.title: Keep agent-only limits
options.body: Adopt only the per-agent budget direction and decline channel-specific overrides and automatic delegation.

recommendation.title: Budget first, delegate later
recommendation.body: Land a generic opt-in budget with channel or group overrides and deterministic block or warning behavior, then design automatic delegation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the existing design review and has adjacent Discord and subagent history spanning the product decision.
